::: {.why}
Quality is the least well-defined of the classic signals, which makes it the best case study in how many specifications you can try before a result stops meaning anything.
:::

## What you should be able to do tonight

- Build gross profitability as specified and say why the denominator choice matters.
- Report how much the signal's measured performance varies across six defensible definitions, and what that implies for the correction you owe.

## Tasks <span class='task-total'>60 min</span>

::: {.task-list}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [35 min]{.task-min} Build the signal as Novy-Marx defines it and generate its page. Then build five other defensible quality definitions, such as return on equity, accruals, leverage, earnings stability and asset growth, and evaluate all six identically.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [25 min]{.task-min} Do the arithmetic you have been building toward all year: six specifications tried means the best of six needs a correction, and your day 61 noise floor gives you the threshold. Report the best specification's raw information ratio, the count, and the corrected verdict. Log all six to research_log.jsonl.
:::
:::

## The running strategy

::: {.project}
Six quality specifications are evaluated identically and all six are logged, so the best one is reported with the correction its selection implies rather than as a discovery.
:::
